name: variantly-demo
description: The variantly product video: recorded by Playwright, voiced by ElevenLabs, rendered by SeekReel.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.edit: node --env-file-if-exists=.env edit.mjs --theme light && node --env-file-if-exists=.env edit.mjs --theme dark
scripts.all: npm run voice && npm run record && npm run edit && npm run build:all
